verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only Gitea's built-in issue tracker, chat-app sync (Slack, Discord, MS Teams), and CI/CD integrations (Drone, Jenkins, and others). Nothing shows integration with an external issue tracker, viewing or managing external tickets inside Gitea, or linking to them from pull requests. Native issues are an adjacent feature and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view and manage tickets from an external issue tracker inside the code host and open them from pull requests
